questions.question: Due to World War I and II the Olympic Games were NOT held in which years?

questions.question:
Select the correct alternative on the basis of the given statements on the cities of Harappan civilisation.

**Statement I:** Most of the Harappan cities were divided into two parts: Higher Town and Lower Town.

**Statement II: **The archaeologists describe the lower part of the towns as Citadel.

options.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are true.
Neither Statement I nor Statement II is true.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Only Statement I is true**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Many of the Harappan or Indus Valley Civilization cities were indeed divided into two major parts.
 
• The "Higher Town" was often a fortified area, which typically housed the public buildings, administrative buildings, and the higher social classes.
 
• The "Lower Town" was where the majority of the populace lived, and it was well-planned with residential areas, markets, streets laid out in a grid pattern, and sophisticated drainage systems. **Hence, statement I is correct.**
 
• In the context of Harappan cities, it is the "Higher Town" or the raised platform part that is often referred to as the Citadel or Acropolis, not the lower part.
 
• The Citadel was usually the area that contained the major public buildings, administrative centers, and possibly religious buildings. Hence, statement II is incorrect.
 
• It was fortified and separated from the lower residential areas, indicating a distinction in social or functional use.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The earliest city discovered in India was Harappa. 
 
• It was excavated in 1921 in the Punjab province of British India.
 
• After the excavation of Harappa as the first site, the Indus Valley Civilisation is also known as Harappan Civilisation hereafter.
 
• It was excavated by Daya Ram Sahni in 1921.
 
• It lies on the bank of river Ravi.

• Eukaryotic organisms have cells with a nucleus enclosed within membranes.
 
• Multicellular organisms are composed of more than one cell, with groups of cells differentiating to take on specialized functions.

 Eukaryotic, multicellular, autotrophic organisms, capable of photosynthesis to produce their own food.
 
 

 4) Bacteria
 Prokaryotic, unicellular organisms, with some autotrophic species but lacking a nucleus and other membrane-bound organelles.

questions.question: Most centrioles have a _____ structure of triple microtubules, which are present in pairs and arranged orthogonally after duplication.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**9 + 0**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Centrioles are present in pairs and are arranged orthogonally after duplication, which is essential for cell division.
 
• Each centriole is composed of nine sets of triplet microtubules arranged in a cylinder.
 
• This 9 + 0 arrangement is crucial for the formation of the centrosome and spindle fibers during mitosis and meiosis. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Centrioles play a key role in cell division, particularly in the process of mitosis and meiosis, where they help in the organization of the mitotic spindle.
 
• They are cylindrical structures that are found in most eukaryotic cells, though absent in higher plants and most fungi.
 
• The duplication of centrioles is a critical step in the cell cycle, ensuring that each daughter cell receives an appropriate number of centrioles.
 
• Abnormalities in centriole structure or number can lead to diseases, including cancer, due to errors in cell division.

questions.question: By which of the following writs the Supreme Court and the High Courts may call for the record of a case from a lower court on an allegation of an excess of jurisdiction?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__Certiorari__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The writ of **Certiorari** is issued by the Supreme Court or High Courts to a lower court or tribunal either to transfer a case pending with them to itself or to squash the order of the lower courts on the grounds of excess of jurisdiction or lack of jurisdiction or error of law.
 
• This writ is a mechanism to ensure judicial review of administrative actions and to keep lower courts and tribunals within the bounds of their jurisdiction.
 
• It is not issued to administrative authorities, legislative bodies, and private individuals or bodies.
 
• The purpose of **Certiorari** is to ensure that the law is applied correctly and to prevent the miscarriage of justice due to jurisdictional errors.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
 

 Option
 Details
 
 

 Prohibition
 Issued by a higher court to a lower court or tribunal to prevent the latter from exceeding its jurisdiction which it does not possess.
 
 

 Mandamus
 Command issued by the court to a lower court, tribunal, or public authority to perform a public or statutory duty.
 
 

 Habeas Corpus
 Means 'to have the body of'. It is an order by the court to a person who has detained another to produce the detainee before the court, to examine the legality of the detention.

• Treatment generally involves surgical removal of the cloudy lens and replacement with an artificial lens.

• Advancements in cataract surgery have made it one of the most successful and life-changing procedures available.

questions.solution:

• **Cloth cleaning using detergent** involves a chemical reaction where the detergent molecules interact with dirt and grease to remove them from the cloth.
 
• **Ripening of mango** is a chemical process where the fruit naturally produces ethylene gas, leading to changes in its texture and sweetness.

• **Cooling effect of nail polish remover** (usually containing acetone) is a physical process, not a chemical one. The cooling sensation is due to the rapid evaporation of acetone on the skin, which absorbs heat from the skin surface.

 A process that leads to the chemical transformation of one set of chemical substances to another. Chemical reactions involve making and breaking of bonds between atoms.
 
 

 **Physical Process**
 A process that affects the form of a chemical substance, but not its chemical composition. Examples include changes in state or temperature.
